title: Teukolsky Energy Decay on Extremal Kerr Spacetimes
exact_target: Prove the stated boundedness, decay and horizon-growth behavior for fixed angular modes of the Teukolsky fields on extremal Kerr.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006046 (OWR-14298591-010). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2024), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2024/36, pp. 2033--2112. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: Decay away from the horizon, decay of the outgoing horizon component and generic growth of the ingoing component are different required conclusions.
